title: Labeled Data Table
description: A rectangular table of labeled columns and numeric rows — the workhorse stimulus for linear/exponential models, ratios, and unit conversion across Algebra and Problem-Solving and Data Analysis. Stems quote the same headers and cell values the table renders.

title.description: Caption above the table; null for an uncaptioned table.

headers.description: Column headers; may include units, e.g. 'Time (minutes)'.

rows.description: Each inner array is one row of cell values; every row must have exactly headers.length cells (renderer rejects otherwise).

items.description: Numbers for data cells; short strings allowed for categorical first columns.

highlightColumn.description: 0-based column index to shade (e.g. the column the question asks about); null for none.

notes: Renderer guarantees: equal column widths, header row bolded with a rule beneath; row-length mismatch with headers is a parse-time error, never a silently truncated figure; numeric cells are rendered exactly as provided (no reformatting), so stem arithmetic always matches the visible table.
